core_claim: 35 years of charting boy bands isn't one genre — it's three or four overlapping waves, and the dataset's visual fields record the turnover frame-by-frame.

edt_01.label: Hook — The look you remember is one of four
edt_01.title: The look you remember is one of four
edt_01.editorial_notes: 5.1% overall and 14.8% peak must be exact. The instance is inst_01 (NSYNC 'It's Gonna Be Me') — the archetypal frosted-tips video.

edt_02.label: 55 bands, 234 boys, 35 years
edt_02.title: 55 bands, 234 boys, 35 years
edt_02.editorial_notes: Year chart should highlight 2000 with 9 bands. Keep det_02's 'fuzzy category' caveat in the prose.

edt_03.label: Bands per era — boom, bust, rebound
edt_03.title: Boom, bust, rebound
edt_03.editorial_notes: Use the era bar chart and consider an image of NKOTB or Boyz II Men to anchor the lineage prose.

edt_04.label: The unofficial uniform
edt_04.title: The unofficial uniform
edt_04.editorial_notes: 47.4% is the load-bearing number. Visualize as a treemap or grid showing how 5 combos cover ~57% of all members. Interactive: 'click any 234 squares to see palette.'

edt_05.label: The frosted-tip fossil layer
edt_05.title: The frosted-tip fossil layer
edt_05.editorial_notes: Era-by-era line chart of frosted-tip rate. Generated video can show animated 'fossil layer' or hair-style transition across decades. 14.8% is the load-bearing number.

edt_06.label: Who sang on Top 40 — and how the racial composition flipped
edt_06.title: Who sang on Top 40
edt_06.editorial_notes: Era-stacked area or two-line chart for skin-tone share. Pair the U.S. Census benchmark in same paragraph as ana_12. Editorially sensitive — keep prose careful and the data caveat visible.

edt_07.label: The hidden chart-topper isn't the dance song
edt_07.title: The hidden chart-topper isn't the dance song
edt_07.editorial_notes: Mini-chart counting #1s by dance speed. The instance here is inst_03 (Boyz II Men 'End of the Road') as the canonical slow-jam #1.

edt_08.label: Hands free — 84% never touch an instrument
edt_08.title: Hands free
edt_08.editorial_notes: Era trend chart of 'plays-instrument %'. Highlight the late-2000s spike (Jonas Brothers / 5SOS rebound).

edt_09.label: Cast at the population mean
edt_09.title: Cast at the population mean
edt_09.editorial_notes: A stat callout, not a chart. Single big number: 69.6 in / 69.1 in median CDC.

edt_10.label: Browse the field
edt_10.title: Browse the field
edt_10.editorial_notes: Card-deck interactive: 7 lineage clusters, each clickable, each opening to a YouTube embed for the canonical band. Use the verified instances inst_01..inst_07.

edt_11.label: Close — the look is the data
edt_11.editorial_notes: Pure prose close — no chart. Restate the three load-bearing numbers (5.1% frosted tips, racial flip, 47.4% uniform) as a closing list.
